rhymes.title: Lakdi Ki Kathi (लकड़ी की काठी)
rhymes.description: Lakdi ki kathi, kathi pe ghoda! Pyara animated ghoda daudta hua gaana.
rhymes.moral: Khushi se gao aur masti karo!

rhymes.title: Chanda Mama Door Ke (चंदा मामा दूर के)
rhymes.description: Puye pakaye boor ke, pyaare Chanda mama ki animated kahani!
rhymes.moral: Sote waqt meethi lori aur pyaar.

rhymes.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
rhymes.description: Up above the world so high, like a diamond in the sky!
rhymes.moral: Night sky and wonders of the stars.

animals.title: Jungle Safari & Wild Animals (जंगल के जानवर)
animals.description: Sher, haathi, aur giraffe jungle me kaise rehte hain dekhein!
animals.moral: Jeevo se pyaar karein aur jungle ki raksha karein.

animals.title: Beautiful Birds of India (सुंदर पक्षी)
animals.description: Mor, tota, aur chidiya ke sundar rang aur pankh!

science_space.title: Our Solar System (हमारा सौरमंडल)
science_space.description: Suraj aur 8 grah kaise ghoomte hain - animated 3D tour!

science_space.title: Water Cycle & Rain (बारिश कैसे होती है?)
science_space.description: Baadal kaise bante hain aur baarish kaise aati hai!
science_space.moral: Jal hi jeevan hai, paani bachayein.

alphabet_phonics.title: ABC Phonics Song (ए बी सी फोनिक्स)
alphabet_phonics.description: A for Apple /a-a-apple/, B for Ball /b-b-ball/ animated phonics!
alphabet_phonics.moral: Roz naye shabd padhein aur seekhein.

stories.title: Pyaasa Kauwa (The Thirsty Crow)
stories.description: Samajhdaar kauwe ne matke me kankad daal kar paani upar laya!
stories.moral: Jahan chah, wahan raah (Wisdom solves big problems).
